translation_exact: When you descend, not to the lower city, but just beneath the Propylaia, there is a spring of water and, close by, a sanctuary to Apollo in a cave. It is believed that here Apollo lay with Kreousa, the daughter of Erechtheus. They say that Philippides was sent as a messenger to Sparta when the Persians had landed on the Greek mainland. Upon his return, he reported that the Lacedaemonians had delayed their departure, as it was their custom not to march out for battle until the moon was at its full. Philippides also related how Pan appeared to him on Mount Parthenion, declaring his goodwill toward the Athenians and promising to come and aid them in battle at Marathon. Thus, due to this announcement, the god Pan has been honored since that time.

Philippides also related how Pan appeared to
him on Mount Parthenion, declaring his
goodwill toward the Athenians and promising
to come and aid them in battle at Marathon.
Thus, due to this announcement, the god Pan
has been honored since that time.
